enum JsonNode {
    Null
    Bool(b bool)
    Number(n float)
    String(s string)
    Array(a []JsonNode)
    Object(o []JsonField)
}

struct JsonField {
    key string
    val JsonNode
}

struct ParseResult {
    ok bool
    val JsonNode
    err string
    pos int
}

fn make_ok(val JsonNode, pos int) -> ParseResult {
    return ParseResult { ok: true, val: val, err: "", pos: pos }
}

fn make_err(msg string, pos int) -> ParseResult {
    return ParseResult { ok: false, val: JsonNode.Null, err: msg, pos: pos }
}

fn ch_quote() -> string {
    return char_to_string(34)
}

fn ch_bs() -> string {
    return char_to_string(92)
}

fn ch_slash() -> string {
    return char_to_string(47)
}

fn ch_lbrace() -> string {
    return char_to_string(123)
}

fn ch_rbrace() -> string {
    return char_to_string(125)
}
